rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a difficult or troubled period, relationship, or situation.

example.english: This has been a rocky period.
example.jyutping: ne1 dyun6 si4 gaan3 gwo3 dak1 hou2 gaan1 naan4

rows.note: Use this for physical terrain or surfaces that contain many rocks, usually before 嘅 + noun.

example.english: This mountain path is rocky, so it’s hard to walk.
example.traditional: 呢條山路好多石頭，行得好辛苦。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 saan1 lou6 hou2 do1 sek6 tau4 haang4 dak1 hou2 san1 fu2

rows.note: Use this when explicitly describing music, an album, or a performance as being in the rock-music style.

example.english: This band’s new album has a rocky sound.
example.traditional: 呢隊樂隊嘅新碟好有搖滾風格。
example.jyutping: ne1 deoi6 ngok6 deoi2 ge3 san1 dip6 hou2 jau5 jiu4 gwan2 fung1 gaak3
